name: Midas mTBILL
oneLiner: mTBILL is Midas's NAV-linked Treasury-bill certificate, with issuer-reported USTB and BUIDL positions and USDC settlement.
collateral: Treasury-bill fund portfolio with issuer-reported USTB and BUIDL positions and an explicitly unclassified residual. The transparency source reports rounded position values and a source timestamp; these are portfolio estimates, not independently examined holdings.
pegMechanism: NAV-linked Treasury-bill certificate rather than a $1 payment token. The July 17, 2026 final terms specify USDC subscription and settlement, issuer-calculated NAV, a one-business-day realisation period, redemption gates of 25% of outstanding mTokens per settlement day, and a holdback of up to 5%; instant redemption uses a deferred-price method.

sources.label: Midas signed SAVE checkpoint: created October 1, 2026; issuer claims, not an independent financial opinion
